message:
## Vulnerability Digest

One newly published vulnerability was verified as relevant to the monitored products during the last 24 hours (2026-08-20 05:10 IST to 2026-08-21 05:10 IST).

**Finding 1: OpenSearch Dashboards remote code execution**

- Affected product/component: OpenSearch Dashboards 3.0.0 through versions before 3.8.0; Amazon OpenSearch Service deployments using the affected Dashboards versions are also listed
- Vulnerability: CVE-2026-18420
- Severity: High (CVSS 3.1: 8.8)
- Description: Improper input validation in the Time Series Visual Builder plugin allows an authenticated remote user with standard data-access permissions to send a crafted JSON payload and execute arbitrary code in the OpenSearch Dashboards server process.
- Relevance: OpenSearch is explicitly included in the monitored product list, and the CVE record directly identifies OpenSearch Dashboards as affected.
- Sources: [OpenSearch security advisory](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch-Dashboards/security/advisories/GHSA-xmqx-xq2p-8jq2) and [CVE record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-18420)

The CVE record was published on 2026-08-20 at 20:40 UTC. The underlying OpenSearch advisory was first published earlier in August, so this digest treats the newly issued CVE record as the in-window development.

Immediate review is recommended for OpenSearch Dashboards deployments in the affected version range. The dedicated MongoDB ecosystem sweep found no credible MongoDB-related advisory newly published or updated within this window. No possible matches needing review remained after validation.
